title: Jesus Heals the Man Born Blind! 👀 He Can See! | Bible Lesson for Kids | Sunday School
tags: jesus heals blind man for kids
top:
Close your eyes tight... can you see the sunshine? 🙈 Now imagine your eyes were closed like that your whole life! Join us for the amazing story of Jesus healing the man born blind, from John 9.

Many people walked right past the blind man, but Jesus stopped. 💛 He made a little mud, put it on the man's eyes, and said, "Go, wash in the pool of Siloam." The man trusted Jesus, washed, and for the very first time in his life, he could see! 👀 Later he met Jesus again and said, "Lord, I believe!"

📖 Memory verse: "...He has opened my eyes!" (John 9:30)
🎯 Lesson: Compassion. Jesus cares for us, and He wants us to stop and help others too!
🙏 Great for Sunday School, Kindergarten and family devotion time.
